payout_quote: Age 18 - 75 years old. Remuneration: $3,565 *with screening reimbursement. Full details outlined in consent form. Male or Female. BMI 18 - 45 kg/m2. Commitment: 5 nights, 1 clinic visit. Medical condition: Kidney Disease.
steps: Open the Nucleus Network renal-impairment study page.
Check eligibility (ages 18-75, kidney impairment, BMI 18-45) and contact the clinic.
Attend the screening visit (screening reimbursement included) and pass screening.
Complete the 5-night stay plus the clinic visit.
Receive remuneration of $3,565 as outlined in the consent form.
catches: Only people with kidney impairment qualify — this is a patient study, not a healthy-volunteer study; not everyone qualifies.
Full remuneration details are in the consent form (screening reimbursement included); you must complete screening and the study schedule.
Time commitment: a 5-night inpatient stay plus a clinic visit.
Real medical risks from the investigational procedures/medication, disclosed in the consent form.
St. Paul, MN location — travel is only covered if study-related transportation/allowances are offered.
biggest_catch: Only people with kidney impairment (ages 18-75, BMI 18-45) qualify for this patient study; the $3,565 requires a 5-night inpatient stay plus a clinic visit and real medical risks disclosed in the consent form.
eligibility: Men and women with kidney impairment, ages 18-75, BMI 18-45 kg/m2; must pass screening.
timing: Remuneration with screening reimbursement; full details outlined in the consent form.
